priorityList: Cast Avenging Wrath (or Radiant Glory) on cooldown, ideally when Expurgation is already ticking on the target.
Cast Execution Sentence (if talented) when Wake of Ashes is nearly ready and Avenging Wrath is active or soon available.
Cast Wake of Ashes if you are not at max Holy Power and Avenging Wrath is active or has more than 6 seconds remaining on cooldown.
Cast Hammer of Light as your highest priority spender, especially if its free proc is about to expire or Avenging Wrath is ending.
Cast Divine Toll on cooldown, ideally during Avenging Wrath.
Cast a Finisher (Divine Storm for AoE) if you are at 5 Holy Power to avoid over-capping.
Cast Divine Storm as your primary spender if there are 3+ targets or if you have an Empyrean Power proc.
Cast Templar's Verdict as your spender if there are fewer than 3 targets and Empyrean Power is not active.
Cast Blade of Justice if Art of War procs to generate Holy Power.
Cast Hammer of Wrath on cooldown.
Cast Blade of Justice to generate Holy Power and maintain Expurgation.
Cast Judgment to generate Holy Power and apply the Judgment debuff.
Cast Templar Strike and Templar Slash as your primary filler generators.
Cast Crusader Strike if no other generators are available.
Cast Arcane Torrent or Light's Judgment during Avenging Wrath for extra burst if available.
